body:
@matsko, that seems to fix the issue, although I still was expecting a different behavior, but I think that may be a different question. Do you know in [this example](https://stackblitz.com/edit/angular-slidein-db17ab-t7vrfx?file=app/app.component.ts) how to make the nested slidein play its leave animation _first_ when you click the backdrop?

**Edit:** Oh, actually nvm, I figured it out, I just need to put the child animation first in the array, duh!

@matsko, this worked for a while, until I introduced a third slidein, then the leave animations don't play in order, and look buggy.

I updated the example here: https://stackblitz.com/edit/angular-slidein-db17ab-zpw87i?file=app%2Fapp.component.ts

To reproduce the issue, open all three slideins, then click on the backdrop and you should see the buggy animations. If you only open two slideins and click on the backdrop then it works fine; the animations play in order and smoothly.

This is using v5.2.5.

Is there something I'm missing to make it work?
